name: @forgeax/platform-io
description: Browser-safe resource, asset, and preference IO abstractions

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --strict --skipLibCheck --verbatimModuleSyntax src/*.ts src/api/*.ts src/resource-substrate/*.ts
scripts.build: tsup src/index.ts src/api/index.ts src/resource-substrate/index.ts --format esm --dts --outDir dist
